I can't confirm either option in the team note. I know of no record that Benjamin Forstner, the Forstner bit's namesake, built an electric motor, and the electric motor is usually credited to Thomas Davenport, born in Williamstown, Orange County, Vermont. So the question likely rests on a false premise, and I can't give a verified county and state for Forstner's birthplace.

CONFIDENCE: 20
